clauses.statement: GitHub Actions may request deployment only for a full application commit SHA contained in origin/main, and the Lightsail principal may execute only the restricted deploy command when the workflow commit control-plane digest matches the installed deployer.
forbidden_patterns: deploy a commit not contained in origin/main
accept a short or malformed commit SHA
run an installed deploy control plane whose digest differs from the workflow commit
bypass the production Environment approval boundary
treat systemd active as proof of Slack or Web outcome
